answer: Sealed-storage uniqueness resists sybils. Each agent locks a slashable bond and must seal one exclusive replica of a public dataset. The crystal commitment, tagged by a unique lotus id, is written to a public knoll of sector records and may bind only a single key. In every short window the key must post a proof of spacetime over that exact replica. A reused commitment, a missed window, or two proofs from one seal slashes every linked deposit. Fielding N identities means sealing and proving N distinct replicas through every window, so disk, sealing work, and capital scale with farm size.
